ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 75% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels across the central lobes against 25% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized at the periphery and notch area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous field across the central and upper regions of both lobes. Contiguous dark pigmentation bands traverse the entire length of the trailing edges, widening at the fluke tips. Significant dark pixel clustering is observed at the basal region surrounding the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped indentation; approximately 45-degree angle at the vertex with symmetric linear slopes transitioning into the medial lobe edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Pixel-level analysis reveals numerous sharp peaks and shallow valleys along the trailing edge, with prominent jagged protrusions located at the distal one-third of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges exhibit a generally linear trajectory from the notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning into a slight upward convexity as they approach the tapered fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct dark, roughly circular ring-shaped pixel clusters (approximate diameter 15-20 pixels) are visible on the right lobe, positioned approximately 20% of the distance from the notch toward the tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple faint, vertically-oriented dark linear streaks on the right lobe, cutting across the high-intensity white surface area, consistent with rake mark morphology.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jaggedness and missing pixel segments along the trailing edge indicate cumulative physical wear or minor historic predation marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique pair of 'C-shaped' dark pigment markings located in the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe's ventral surface.
